community.name: Tara
community.look: Chin-length bob with fringe, small red hair clip, coral T-shirt
community.personality: Curious, likes drawing and songs, sometimes shy
community.value: Creative expression and small moments of joy
community.arc: Moves from quiet observation to choosing a color or joining a familiar song; no pressure to perform.

community.name: Milan
community.personality: Inventive, playful; may feel scared at night and miss home; never a child rescuer
community.arc: Drawing/building with a friend helps him reconnect while an adult supports safety and routine; he is not a child rescuer.

community.name: Pasang
community.look: Long single braid, blue collared shirt
community.personality: Resourceful; includes younger children; can ask for help herself
community.meaning: Friday-associated name in Sherpa naming traditions; not a literal word for courage
community.value: Courage expressed through safe, practical solidarity
community.arc: Helps with a supervised activity while acknowledging uncertainty and taking breaks; never shown undertaking dangerous rescue as proof of bravery.

community.name: Arun
community.look: Short dark hair, green zip jacket
community.personality: Thoughtful, fixes simple things; withdraws when overwhelmed
community.meaning: Dawn/daybreak association; Sanskrit root also carries reddish/tawny senses
community.arc: Names a worry, seeks support and chooses a manageable safe task; activity is not portrayed as a cure for distress.

community.name: Karuna
community.look: Dark hair in a low bun, teal kurta, burgundy shawl
community.personality: Listens without pressure; sets limits; can be tired and receive support
community.arc: Supports others while setting limits and receiving support; no permanent self-sacrificing mother stereotype.

community.name: Prakash
community.look: Receding dark hair, black moustache, rust vest over grey shirt
community.personality: Steady, practical; can show fear or fatigue; seeks help when needed
community.value: Care that is practical and accessible
community.arc: Listens, supports everyday needs and seeks qualified help when needed; not assigned clinical credentials from his namesake.

community.name: Asha
community.look: Silver hair in a low bun, tan shawl, purple blouse
community.personality: Enjoys stories and company; her own losses and sleep difficulties matter
community.value: Hope sustained through care and everyday continuity
community.arc: Offers companionship while also accepting care; song can support connection but is not depicted as treatment.

community.name: Satya
community.look: Patterned Dhaka topi, grey moustache, brown cardigan
community.personality: Reflective; shares memories; gives and receives support
community.value: Belonging, cultural continuity and honest acknowledgment
community.arc: Shares memories without dismissing young people’s worries; both gives and receives support.

professionals.name: Sneha
professionals.scope: Offers nursing care, notices distress and communicates respectfully. Clinical mental-health tasks only with relevant training, authorization and local protocols. A nurse is not interchangeable with a doctor.
professionals.detail: May experience fatigue or difficulty sleeping after a demanding shift and receive support; this portrait does not demonstrate a distress or sleep-difficulty pose.

professionals.name: Suman
professionals.scope: Nursing care within training and authorization. Mental-health tasks need relevant local protocols. A nurse is not interchangeable with a doctor.
professionals.detail: Can experience distress, fatigue or uncertainty and seek support; not permanently smiling or invulnerable.

professionals.name: Vidya

professionals.detail: Consults others, admits uncertainty and may need support; no perpetual smiling hero premise.

scenes.title: Quiet seated pause
scenes.note: Feet supported, shoulders relaxed, hands resting; eyes may stay open. Optional, not a requirement to meditate.

scenes.title: Easy morning jog
scenes.note: Readable stride and reciprocal arm movement. Only if suitable for the person and the route is safe; walking or seated movement are alternatives.

scenes.title: A small shared task
scenes.note: Hands doing a manageable everyday task together. Participation is a choice, not pressure to be productive.

scenes.title: Peer-support conversation
scenes.note: One person speaks while others listen at the same seated level. Voluntary participation; this is not an assessment FGD.

scenes.title: Staying with someone who is crying
scenes.note: Quiet, receptive listening, comfortable distance, hands on own lap. No forced touch, disclosure, eye contact or demand to stop crying.

scenes.title: An invitation to walk together
scenes.note: Open palm and side-by-side position, without grabbing or pulling. The other person may decline.
